business_problem: In collaboration with Microsoft, the Ministry of Economy was able to work on the goal of worker placement through Sine, with the purpose of improving profiling and creating a more assertive algorithm for worker placement. In 2019, the Ministry of Economy, an agency linked to the federal government, set a goal: to increase the placement rate of the National Employment System (Sine, in Portuguese) – a platform aimed at the insertion of workers into the labor market. Sine was under the Ministry of Economy until 2021, when the Ministry of Labor was re-established, and the system was relocated.
Sine's employee database serves approximately 20 million people every year who register their data and can go through labor qualification and even hiring processes.

"We had the challenge of creating a profiling algorithm for those we serve, a mechanism with the application of statistical techniques, and we sought to identify workers who are at greater risk in the labor market, greater difficulty," explains Amilton Lobo Mendes Junior, Foreign Trade analyst and general coordinator of Special Projects linked directly to the secretary at the Ministry of Labor.
